title: Partner webhooks rejected after secret rotation

correctStatements.text: At 15:00 dalia reported partner callbacks failing since lunch.
At 15:07 hugo saw the endpoint answer 401 on every webhook because the signature check failed.
The signing secret was rotated that morning and only one of the two verifying services was updated.
At 15:30 hugo pushed the new secret to the second service.
At 15:38 sol saw webhooks return 200 again.
At 15:50 sol saw the retries draining with the failed callback queue down to about 300.
At 16:10 dalia heard from the partner that nothing was missing on their side.
About an hour of callbacks were rejected but no data was lost thanks to partner retries.
Hugo will write a rotation runbook that lists every service that holds the secret.
Sol will add a canary webhook that is sent after each rotation.
